text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとクラウドは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Cloud are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとクラウドは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Cloud are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
あなたの選択は、かつてのクラウドと同じ。
彼の決意は……「俺は俺の現実を生きる」
text.official_en: Cloud made much the same decision as you, for he vowed that he would be true to himself—that he would no longer live his life “pretending.”
text.real_en: You have chosen as Cloud once did. His resolve was: “I will live my own reality.”

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いつか現実を越えて、新しい運命を生きる……。
幻想だとしても、希望は誰にも否定できません。
text.official_en: Whether illusory or genuine, they are free to roam wherever and whenever they wish—free to transcend even reality if they so please.
text.real_en: One day you might go beyond reality and live a new destiny... Even if it seems a fantasy, no one can deny your hope.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
かけがえのない存在を、失ってしまった。
そんな耐えがたい現実にぶつかったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you forced to face a most grim and unbearable truth—that you had lost someone who was both a close friend and an invaluable ally—how would you react?
text.real_en: If you lost someone irreplaceable and had to face that unbearable reality... what would you do?

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
そして真実を知るうちに、クラウドは自分の
過去に違和感を抱きはじめるのです。
text.official_en: At the same time, however, doubt crept into his thoughts; something about his past was amiss.

text.jp: それでも現実を生きる
text.official_en: Concentrate on the mission at hand.
text.real_en: Keep living in the real world, even so.

text.jp:
それでも過去に向き合うと覚悟を決めたなら
打ちのめされても、きっと強くなれるでしょう。
text.official_en: While confronting them may prove to be an unpleasant experience, the reward for enduring such an ordeal is sure to be great.
text.real_en: Even if facing the past breaks your spirit, the decision to confront it can help you grow stronger.

text.jp: それは、命と想いが星をめぐる異界の記憶――
text.official_en: In this world, life and memories themselves flow throughout the planet.

text.jp:
ただ、クラウドが乗り込んだのは
途中下車できない列車だったのです。
text.official_en: Cloud, however, leapt onto a metaphorical train that would not stop until it reached the end of the line.
text.real_en: But the train Cloud boarded was one he could not get off halfway.

text.jp: とりあえず流れに乗る
text.official_en: “Let’s see where this goes.”

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
やがて暗躍する欲望と悪意が争いを招き、
星の命を終わらせる破局が迫ります。
text.official_en: As malevolence and avarice wrought greater havoc and embroiled the world in further conflict, the planet seemed ever more likely to perish.

text.jp:
クラウドの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.

text.jp:
クラウドは、とまどいを覚えつつも剣を捨てず
倒すべき敵を追って、旅を続けました。
text.official_en: Though his uncertainties were many, Cloud eventually conquered them. He chose not to cast his sword aside, but rather to keep it raised in defiance.
text.real_en: Though confused, Cloud did not lay down his sword. He continued his journey in pursuit of the enemy he had to defeat.

text.jp:
クラウドも、はじめはさほど興味を持たず
星の危機を訴える声を聞き流していました。
text.official_en: At first, Cloud, too, paid little attention to others’ cries about the planet’s future; they went in one ear and out the other.

text.jp:
クラウドもまずは仕事として引き受けましたが
それが運命に踏み込む第一歩となったのです。
text.official_en: Similarly, though Cloud’s original assignment did blossom into a cross-continental journey, he only undertook it for the pay.
text.real_en: Cloud accepted the work as a job at first, but it became his first step into his destiny.

text.jp: 仕事なら引き受ける
text.official_en: “As long as I get paid...”
text.real_en: Take the job, if it pays.

text.jp: 他人の生き方に目を向ける
text.official_en: Look to others and see how they live.

text.jp:
仲間たちの人生にかかわって知ること、感じること。
想いは絆となって、クラウドたちを導きました。
text.official_en: By sharing their experiences with one another, Cloud and his companions learned much and more on their adventure; all they saw and heard offered them insight.
text.real_en: Through his companions’ lives, Cloud learned and felt many things. Their shared feelings became bonds that guided them.

text.jp: 倒すべき敵を追いかける
text.official_en: Continue pursuing your enemy.

text.jp:
命と想いが星をめぐる異界の幻影　クラウド
偽りの自分と向き合い、過去を断って未来へ。
text.official_en:
Champion of the Planet Cloud
The mercenary who confronted his false self and made peace with his past.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision from a planet where life and feelings flow: Cloud. He faces his false self, leaves the past behind and moves toward the future.

text.jp:
喪失にさいなまれたクラウドが立ち直れたのは
支えてくれる仲間がそばにいてくれたからでした。
text.official_en: Cloud, too, felt immense grief for some time, and yet, he was able to overcome it thanks to the support of his companions.

text.jp:
大切な存在を失った痛みから逃げることなく、
悲しみを背負いながら前を向いて、生きる。
text.official_en: While there is no denying the pain of losing someone important, you choose to confront it and overcome it, rather than to run from it.
text.real_en: You would face your grief without running from it and live on, carrying the sorrow of losing someone precious.

text.jp:
失った存在を想いつづけて嘆くあまりに
今の自分に残されたものを忘れてはなりません。
text.official_en: To grieve for one’s losses is only natural. To grieve overmuch, however, can blind one to all that remains in one’s life.

text.jp:
彼の名は、クラウド……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That mercenary’s name was Cloud Strife, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Cloud... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
彼はさまざまな人々に出会い、時には戦って
星をめぐる策謀の深淵へと踏み込みます。
text.official_en: As Cloud connected with new people and did battle with various foes, he inched ever closer to uncovering the truth behind his planet’s plight.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp:
思い出すことなく、忘れたほうが幸せ……
そんな記憶が、誰にだってあるものです。
text.official_en: Life cannot always be moonlight and roses; everyone has memories they would rather consign to oblivion.
text.real_en: Everyone has memories they'd be happier forgetting than recalling.

text.jp:
思い悩むより、まずは流れに飛び込んでから
自分で感じ、考えてみてもよいでしょう。
text.official_en: In certain cases, it may behoove one to leap before they look, rather than mire themselves in contemplation.

text.jp:
戦う理由は問わず、報酬があれば協力する。
冷たいようでも堅実で、頼りになる答えです。
text.official_en: You would lend your sword to any cause...as long as your efforts are sufficiently rewarded. Though it may sound callous, it is a shrewd business practice.
text.real_en: You would help without asking why they fight, as long as you were paid. It may sound cold, but it is a practical, dependable answer.

text.jp:
星のエネルギーを消費して栄える大都市。
その陰で利用され、虐げられる人々……。
text.official_en: This liquid life-force was harvested and used to power a metropolis, in which many of its citizens were exploited and oppressed.
text.real_en: A great city prospered by consuming the planet’s energy, while people in its shadow were exploited and oppressed...

text.jp:
星の危機が迫っていると言われても
なかなか実感がわかないものです。
text.official_en: A reasonable response, for a threat can be difficult to grasp when not immediately apparent.

text.jp:
星の存亡にかかわる戦いのさなか
クラウドは大切な存在を失いました。
text.official_en: Cloud’s situation was hardly advantageous—and it worsened when he lost someone who could never be replaced.
text.real_en: In the midst of the battle for the planet's survival, Cloud lost someone precious to him.

text.jp:
星の支配を狙う者、星の破壊を願う者に
立ち向かった、ひとりの青年がいました。
text.official_en: Into this fetid city strode a mercenary—one who would confront both those who wished to rule the planet, and those who wished to destroy it.
text.real_en: A young man stood against those who sought to rule the planet and those who wished to destroy it.

text.jp:
星を守るために、強大な権力との戦いに
加わってほしいと、誘われたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you asked to save the planet, but in doing so, must combat an organization with nigh unlimited authority, what would you think?
text.real_en: If someone asked you to join a fight against a mighty power to protect the planet... what would you do?

text.jp:
星を守る戦いのさなか、これまでの自分の
生き方に、迷いが生じてしまったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to be assailed by doubts about how you had lived your life—all while on a mission that would decide the very fate of your planet—what would you do?
text.real_en: If you began to doubt the way you had lived while fighting to protect the planet... what would you do?

text.jp: 残されたものを大事にする
text.official_en: Focus not on what was lost, but what remains.

text.jp:
自分のことだけでなく、他者に目を向けてみる。
視点を変えて気づくことも多いはずです。
text.official_en: A change of perspective can build a foundation for new discoveries. Look not only inward, but outward as well.

text.jp: 自分の過去と記憶に向き合う
text.official_en: Confront your past and your memories of it.

text.jp: 興味ないね
text.official_en: “Not interested.”

text.jp:
起こったことは変えられない。それが現実です。
けれど人の想いは、どこまでも自由であるはず。
text.official_en: That which has transpired cannot be undone—such is our reality. Yet hopes and dreams are not bound by the same restraints.

text.jp: 運命を変えようとあがく
text.official_en: Strive to change fate.

text.jp:
過去に疑念があろうと、戦わねば未来はない。
真実にたどりつくのは、生き残った者だけ……。
text.official_en: You may harbor doubts about your past, but they will matter little should your opponent prevail. To learn the truth, you must first live long enough to discover it.
text.real_en: Even if you doubt your past, there will be no future unless you fight. Only those who survive can reach the truth...
